title: 第三千五百九十三章 互坑第三千五百九十二章 复活
content_zh:
“是啊，只要活着，就有希望。”
时间之树看了负面之王一眼，说道，没错，我还有希望，但不好意思，你的希望没了。
时间之树现在已经是安德鲁的人，呃，不，是树，负面之王自然不会有什么好下场，随即，时间之树想到什么，悄悄看了旁边的大头统领一眼。
想要彻底解决负面之王，必须先搞定这个大头统领，虽然时间之树是负面之王的第一智囊，但负面之王有大头统领这个第二智囊，不会任由时间之树摆布。
所以，必须先解决大头统领，到时，负面之王就会变成时间之树的傀儡，被祂轻松坑死。
时间之树不知道的是，此刻大头统领心里，也在思索怎么搞定时间之树？不搞定时间之树，自己算计负面之王的时候，肯定会被察觉。
为什么时间之树和大头统领都不知道对方是自己人？当然是因为安德鲁的隐瞒。
安德鲁之所以隐瞒这件事，主要是担心有一人泄漏，会连累到另一人，而且，即使告诉祂们真相，祂们也还是会内斗的。
都是顶级智者，哪会心甘情愿给别人辅助？反正都会内斗，不如不告诉祂们，这样破绽还少。
就像警方给帮派送卧底，不可能让卧底们相互认识，上一世安德鲁看《无间道》的时候，就对开头那个矮子把所有卧底召集在一起开会表示无语，这是真不怕被一锅端啊？
除此之外，还有些其他原因，以后再说。
“说说吧，现在什么情况？”
时间之树吐出一口气，双眼恢复神采的问道，负面之王闻言点了点头，将‘新剧本世界’的事情重新说了一遍，不过，大头统领帮祂出气的事，祂没说。
这件事说实话，有点意气用事，不符合明主的风范，所以负面之王不愿意和时间之树说。
跟大头统领说没事，因为那是祂的手下，亲信，心腹，根本不用在乎自己在她心中的形象，因为对方百分百忠诚。
时间之树就不一样了，祂算是合作伙伴，没有归心，负面之王要在祂面前表示出明主的样子，不能给自己的形象抹黑。
“机械魔王果然是心狠手黑。”
时间之树忍不住摇头，祂说道：“我先看剧本，等看完之后，再和你说用什么作弊手段。”
负面之王闻言有些不满，时间之树的意思是到时直接通知祂，而不是和祂商量，这可真让人恼火，还是大头统领好，事事请示。
“行，你先看剧本。”

为了大局，负面之王决定先忍下来，到时时间之树出的主意如果没大头统领好，那就别怪祂不给面子。
接着，时间之树开始阅读剧本，刚看完第一段，祂就懵逼了，这是人能写出来的剧本？
时间之树很聪明，越聪明的人，越在乎书籍的逻辑性，因为聪明的人读书的时候，会忍不住分析书里的剧情，设定等等，而这个剧本，没有任何逻辑性。
时间之树一分析，就感觉自己脑袋要炸，这什么玩意啊，不是不合理，而是完全没有合理这东西。
content_en:
"Yes, as long as you are alive, there is hope."
The Tree of Time glanced at the King of Negativity and said, yes, I still have hope, but I'm sorry, your hope is gone.
The Tree of Time is now Andrew's, uh, no, it's a tree. The King of Negativity will naturally not have a good end. Then, the Tree of Time thought of something and quietly glanced at the big leader next to him.
If you want to completely solve the Negative King, you must first get rid of the Big Head Commander. Although the Tree of Time is the first think tank of the Negative King, the Negative King has the Big Head Commander as the second think tank and will not be at the mercy of the Tree of Time.
Therefore, the big leader must be dealt with first. When the time comes, the Negative King will become a puppet of the Tree of Time and be easily tricked to death by him.
What the Tree of Time doesn't know is that at this moment, Commander Big Head is also thinking about how to get the Tree of Time? If you don't take care of the Tree of Time, you will definitely be noticed when you plot against the King of Negativity.
Why don’t the Tree of Time and the Big Head Commander know that the other is one of their own? Of course it was because of Andrew's concealment.
The main reason why Andrew concealed this matter was because he was worried that if one person leaked, it would implicate the other person. Moreover, even if he told them the truth, they would still fight among themselves.
They are all top wise men, how can they be willing to help others? There will be internal fighting anyway, so it's better not to tell them, so there will be fewer flaws.
Just like the police sending undercover agents to gangs, it is impossible for the undercover agents to get to know each other. When Andrew watched "Infernal Affairs" in his previous life, he was speechless when the dwarf at the beginning called all the undercover agents together for a meeting. Are you really not afraid of being blamed?
In addition, there are other reasons, which will be discussed later.
"Tell me, what's going on now?"
The Tree of Time exhaled and asked with his eyes regained their vitality. The King of Negativity nodded when he heard the words and told the story of the 'New Script World' again. However, he did not say anything about the big head commander helping him to vent his anger.
To be honest, this matter is a bit emotional and does not conform to the style of the Ming Lord, so the Negative King is unwilling to talk to the Tree of Time.
It's okay to tell the commander-in-chief, because they are his subordinates, confidants, and confidants. She doesn't need to care about her image in her heart at all, because the other party is 100% loyal.
The Tree of Time is different. He is a partner and has no home. The King of Negativity must show himself as a wise master in front of him and cannot tarnish his own image.
"The Machine Demon King is indeed cruel and evil."
The Tree of Time couldn't help but shake its head, and said, "I'll read the script first, and then I'll tell you what cheating methods I'll use after reading it."
The King of Negativity was a little dissatisfied when he heard this. The Tree of Time meant to notify him directly instead of discussing with him. This was really annoying. It was better for the big leader to ask for instructions on everything.
"Okay, you read the script first."
For the sake of the overall situation, the King of Negativity decided to endure it for the time being. If the Tree of Time's ideas are not well managed by the leader, then don't blame him for not giving face.
Then, the Tree of Time began to read the script. As soon as he read the first paragraph, he was confused. Is this a script that a human can write?
The Tree of Time is very smart. The smarter the person, the more they care about the logic of the book, because when smart people read, they can't help but analyze the plot, settings, etc. in the book, and this script has no logic.
As soon as the Tree of Time analyzed it, I felt like my head was going to explode. What the hell is this? It's not unreasonable, but there is no such thing as reasonable at all.
